name: Glormungost

items.name: Sickle
items.description: Originally a farming tool used for reaping grain, this one-handed weapon has a short wooden handle ending in a curved blade, sometimes sharpened on both sides.

generalAbilities.name: Blood Bombs
generalAbilities.description: Glormungost carries 6 glass vials filled with alchemically treated blood that deal persistent bleed damage, and 2 splash slashing damage. Glormungost replenishes these bombs each day using blood drawn from prisoners.

savenote: +2 status to all saves vs. auditory and visual

hp.note: coffin restoration, fast healing 7, void healing

defensiveAbilities.name: Fast Healing 7
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A monster with this ability regains the given number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn.

defensiveAbilities.name: Coffin Restoration
defensiveAbilities.description: Unlike other undead, a vampire isn't destroyed at 0 HP. Instead, it falls Unconscious. If its body rests in its coffin for 1 hour, the vampire gains 1 HP, after which its fast healing begins to function normally.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Assume Form
offensiveAbilities.description: The ugothol spends 10 minutes reshaping its appearance to take on the shape of any Small or Medium humanoid. It gains a +4 circumstance bonus to Deception checks to pass as that creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Compression
offensiveAbilities.description: When the ugothol successfully Squeezes, it moves through the tight space at full speed. Narrow confines are not difficult terrain for an ugothol.

offensiveAbilities.name: Drink Blood
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirement A Grabbed, Paralyzed, Restrained, Unconscious, or willing creature is within the vampire's reach.

Effect The vampire uses its tongue to drink the creature's blood. This requires an athletics|defense:fortitude check against the victim's Fortitude DC if the victim is grabbed and is automatic for any of the other conditions.

The victim is Drained 2 and the vampire regains 6 Healing Damage HP, gaining any excess HP as temporary Hit Points. Drinking Blood from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to the vampire but increases the victim's drained value by 1, killing the victim when it reaches drained 5. A vampire can also consume blood that's been emptied into a vessel for sustenance, but it gains no HP from doing so.

A victim's drained condition decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a DC 20 Medicine check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drain by 1 after 10 minutes.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Bombardier
offensiveAbilities.description: Glormungost draws a blood bomb with an Interact action and throws it as a ranged Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Revert Form
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The ugothol is in an assumed form

Effect The ugothol resumes its true form. Until the start of its next turn, it gains a +2 status bonus to attack rolls, damage rolls, saving throws, and skill checks.

Effect: Revert Form

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: Glormungost deals 1d6 extra precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.

lv5spells.name: Truespeech (Constant)
lv5spells.description:
The target can understand all words regardless of language and also speak the languages of other creatures. When in a mixed group of creatures, each time the target speaks, it can choose a creature and speak in a language that creature understands, even if the target doesn't know what language that is.

Heightened (7th) The duration is 8 hours.
